data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 28/0841Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL MOVING WEST-NORTHWESTWARD OFFSHORE OF SOUTHWESTERN MEXICO. As of 3:00 AM CST Mon Sep 28 the center of Rachel was located near 13.4, -100.4 with movement WNW at 8 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1001 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 28/0845Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY PERSISTS IN THE CENTRAL ATLANTIC. As of 9:00 AM GMT Mon Sep 28 the center of Fay was located near 27.9, -44.1 with movement SSW at 7 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1012 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 28/0549Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: LIFE-THREATENING WINDS AND FLASH FLOODS EXPECTED OVER PORTIONS OF BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR AND SONORA MONDAY AND TUESDAY. ...CONDITIONS EXPECTED TO BEGIN TO DETERIORATE MONDAY MORNING IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR... As of 11:00 PM MST Sun Sep 27 the center of Polo was located near 23.2, -114.0 with movement N at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 954 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 120 mph.
